title: (Un)Safe transfur
description: A mod about getting transfurred in not necesarily the safest ways.
body:
**(Un)Safe transfur** is a mod about getting transfurred in less 'safe' ways than for example, the Stasis Chamber.

Current list of features:
- Suspicious Syringe - relatively cheap serum that should, in theory, allow it's user to get safely transfurred. ~~Warning: after using the serum, the user might experience minor side effects~~
- Consciousness Syringe - A more expensive version of the Suspicious Serum. It's more powerful than it's main crafting ingredient, and doesn't have most of the side effects.
